description: Lists every served GraphQL root field. query-api enforces no catalog action (actions.v1.json) on a field today, so every action is unknown with a declared gap. Every other statement is held to a source proof by the Go guard.

rows.disclosure_behavior: a whole-operation error before any field runs: 'A valid organization ID is required' for an empty, padded or non-string orgId; 'Only one organization may be queried per operation' for differing orgIds; 'Authorization required' when the caller has no organization; 'Access denied: cannot query org' when the orgId is not the caller's organization, except that a verified non-impersonating superuser with an organization may name another and the operation then runs against it (OperationOrgGuard)
gaps: action: the action this field would map to is not enforced in query-api today; declared gap, not proven by a handler-source test in this change; tracked in CHAOS-11042; no consumer may treat it as allow
